summary: The default road's ledger columns and its ledger path (cinatra#3029, epic #3023 W5). FOUR additive nullable columns on artifact_materializations — detection_rung (text: explicit | signature | structure | name | model | base, the ladder rung that decided the output's form), detection_reason (text: why that rung decided as it did), detection_confidence (double precision: the model rung's confidence, null on every other rung) and detection_model (text: the model the model rung used, null on every other rung) — plus a widened path CHECK that gains 'default_road'. WHY: before this slice an end-node output that no binding named was typed by ONE classifier call against the agent's declared output types and, on a miss, was dropped with a 'not captured' advisory; nothing recorded why an output was named what it was named, because there was only ever one way to name it. The default road types every qualifying end-node output at or above the document floor through a ladder of six rungs (the explicit statement, the bytes' signature, the structural probes, the file's name and extension, the organisation's configured model, the base), so the ledger row must carry the deciding rung or the decision is unauditable. The retired 'derived_output' value stays legal so historical rows keep reading. Rewriting a CHECK constraint is a constraint change, not a data rewrite: no row is touched and every existing row satisfies the widened predicate. No backfill: every existing row reads NULL on all four columns, which is exactly right — those rows were written by paths that do not run the ladder; the repo's standing pre-release no-backward-compat convention, recorded here and in the PR body. Idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL in buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries (src/lib/drizzle-store.ts), shipped in the SAME PR (core__0091 / core__0101 precedent). down() drops the four columns and narrows the CHECK again — reversible only while no default_road row exists, which is the honest outcome. SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: the shipped max on the default branch at authoring time is core__0101; if another branch claims 0102 first, renumbering onto the next free number at merge is the rename the convention expects.
